ValidationRule.description: If Employment status is self employed then length of service is mandatory field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Employment_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Employment_Status__c, "Self Employed"), ISBLANK(cc_Occupation__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Employment Status is Self Employed then Occupation field is mandatory.
